key_insight: SUMNO translates a multigrid V-cycle into a U-shaped neural operator, improving fluid-flow prediction with 9.4 million parameters.
engineering_relevance: The architecture offers a compact CFD surrogate for steady and unsteady flows on regular grids.
method: Spatially unrolls a V-cycle using parameter-free down/up sampling and additive coarse-grid correction skips.
Keeps transfer and skip pathways normalization-free.
Combines fine/intermediate-grid convolutions with coarse-grid shifted-window attention supporting per-axis periodicity.
evidence_signal: Across four benchmarks and five baselines, SUMNO ranks first in 5 of 7 settings and second in two, reducing 10-step rollout MSE by about 30% versus the strongest baseline.
watch_item: The reported evidence is for regular grids; applicability to irregular meshes and stability beyond the evaluated rollout horizon remain unestablished.
paper_title: SUMNO: Spatially Unrolled Multigrid Neural Operator for Fluid Flow Surrogates
